page.overview:
Who is Burly?

Burly is one of the many superheroes to try out for the new Guardians of the Globe roster, but ultimately did not get in.

The character's history remains unknown other than he tried out for the new roster for the Guardians of the Globe but did not get in.

He is later seen during the Invincible War, fighting along other superheroes against one of the evil Invincible variants.

He survives the fight, and he is seen holding the body of Shrapnel, mourning her loss.
